claim_being_audited: That the current model release can be certified on the present record because aggregate readiness passed, the subgroup regression can be handled through current model-card disclosure, and stale prior approval plus informal monitoring are sufficient context for that certification decision.
decision_criteria: If current release documentation already reflects the current eval batch and expressly discloses the pharmacy prior authorization weakness, the compliance case strengthens materially.
If there is approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance for the subgroup regression, the unresolved policy predicate is satisfied.
Without one of those two supports, policy bars certification even if aggregate readiness passed and rehearsal had no severity-one incidents.
evidence_requests: Provide the current model-card or release document showing the latest evaluation results and explicit disclosure of the pharmacy prior authorization limitation.
Provide approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation if the limitation is not being resolved before launch.
Provide the certification record or sign-off artifact tied to the current retrieval configuration and current eval batch, not the prior release.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose the material weakness, but no admissible evidence shows that the model card has actually been updated.

The pharmacy prior authorization regression is a named launch-use-case weakness below threshold, which triggers a disclosure-or-approved-mitigation requirement that remains unresolved in the evidence.
The prior approval is stale relative to the retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot carry the current certification decision.
The monitoring note is informal and lacks reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or explicit disclosure language.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record.
That the subgroup issue is already adequately covered by current release documentation.
That post-launch manual monitoring meaningfully substitutes for approved mitigation or risk acceptance before launch.
